text:
Nora: Heads-up: someone renamed the office kettle to "Flint" and put a tiny sticker on it. Who is the kettle whisperer? :kettle: :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Sam: Not me but I endorse. Flint has presence. We should have an origin story.
Tess: Origin story suggestion: Flint was forged in the fires of the breakroom, tempered by lukewarm water, and blessed by the first tea spill.
Liam: I vote for a weekly ritual: every Tuesday at 10am, bring a novelty tea bag and leave it as an offering to Flint.
Nora: We did this once and someone left a teabag shaped like a hedgehog. Peak office culture. :hedgehog:
Sam: Also propose we add an official epithet: "Flint, Keeper of Boil" or "Flint the Mildly Indignant". React :one: for Keeper, :two: for Mildly Indignant.
Tess: I like "Mildly Indignant". It's very him.
Liam: CoffeeBot, can you set a recurring reminder: "Tea Offering to Flint" Tuesdays 10:00am in #random?
CoffeeBot: Reminder created: "Tea Offering to Flint" 0: Tuesdays 10:00am. Ping channel #random.
Nora: Also we should keep a tiny ledger for offerings — name + tea type + emoji. I can make a Google Sheet called "Flint's Ledger" and add a column for boons.
Sam: Adding a Tiny Ritual: if you take the last teabag, replace it or leave a haiku. Mandatory haiku for chronic offenders.
Tess: Haiku example: "Steam ghosts on the lid / Papers wait for caffeine's hug / Flint accepts my tea." :sparkles:
Liam: Can we make a micro-badge in the snippet: "Flint Friend" for people who’ve left offerings three times? I will wear it proudly.
Nora: Prize idea: first person to hit 10 offerings gets a tiny felt kettle pin. I have felt.
Sam: Also FYI, someone left a note on Flint that said "Do not disturb, meditating." I respect that boundary.
Tess: For the ledger entries, please include if the offering was solemn, accidental, or mischievous. There's a difference.
Liam: Closing: Thanks to the anonymous kettle namer. Workplace lore is thriving. Long live Flint.
Nora: Okay ceremonial first offering tomorrow. I'll bring the hedgehog teabag for dramatic effect.
CoffeeBot: Reminder: "Tea Offering to Flint" triggered tomorrow 10:00am.
Sam: Can't wait. I wrote a tiny ditty for Flint and will perform it at the ritual. No pressure. :notes:
